record.frame_model: One printed dash is an erased coordinate in its visible slot. No insertion, deletion, or reordering.
record.interpretation: To General Government Warsaw: the garrison of Siedlce and Minsk Maziowicki has arrived in Thorn; the whereabouts of Battalion Ostrowo are unknown. Signed General von Zedlitz, hitherto military governor of Siedlce.

independent_context.title: Kreisblatt für den Kreis Grojec / Dziennik rozporządzeń dla powiatu Grójeckiego
independent_context.finding: The bilingual contemporary notice is signed at Siedlce by military governor Freiherr von Zedlitz, Generalmajor. Both the German and Polish signatures are visually legible.
independent_context.scope: Supports the name and office in the proposed signature. It does not independently attest the November withdrawal, Thorn destination, Minsk spelling, or battalion identity.
